title: Pip and the Little Bug
checkpoint: Reception Summer 2, week 2 — Phase 4: With long vowel sounds: adjacent consonants in words with long vowel sounds (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 70-sound stage (st, sw, tr just added).

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow trotting along a puddle-dotted path.
Pip spotting a tiny unfamiliar bug on the path ahead.

pages.text: Pip has not had this bug.
pages.illustration: Pip looking closely at the small bug, having never seen one like it before.
Pip the sparrow tapping the bug gently with his beak.
Pip the sparrow picking up a small bit of the bug.
Pip stopping still, considering the new taste.

pages.text: This bug is not like a nut.
pages.illustration: Pip comparing the bug’s taste to a nut in his mind, clearly different.
Pip the sparrow taking one more little bit.

pages.text: Pip is glad. Pip had a good snack.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking pleased, having enjoyed his unusual snack.
